description: Public holidays, school holidays (often regional, with ISO 3166-2 region codes) and official peak traffic days (France, Bison Futé) in one country for a period of up to 400 days. A country without data returns an error saying so — never present that as "no holidays". Use it for public holidays, days off, school holidays and peak traffic days.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. FR.

from.description: Start of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

kind.description: Only one kind: public holidays, school holidays (often regional), or traffic = official peak traffic days — France only (Bison Futé). For «when are the roads busy» elsewhere omit it: public and school holidays are the busy days. Omit for all.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

to.description: End of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to from + 90 days; at most 400 days after from.

name: get_holidays
title: Holidays And Peak Traffic Days
